definitions: Harmful acts directed at an individual based on their gender. It is rooted in gender inequality, the abuse of power, and harmful norms.
Violence that is perpetrated against someone because of their gender, often disproportionately affecting women and girls.
examples: Campaigns aim to eradicate gender-based violence in all its forms.
Education is key to preventing gender-based violence.
Survivors of gender-based violence require comprehensive support services.
